digest.component_or_area: Jira Data Center transport test suites (heldout parity tests)
propositions: The PAT-repr test is a tautology: it constructs a transport that never receives a PAT and the class defines no __repr__, so the credential-leak contract its docstring promises is never asserted.

The structural-guard teeth test re-implements the AST predicate inline instead of calling the shared audit helper, so it can only fail if the ast module itself breaks; the helper must be parameterized with an optional source argument so the synthetic unpaginated source can be fed through and the offender reported.

The validate_assignee_exists test only asserts hasattr, duplicating the presence test, while nothing asserts the DC path returns a username string (not a bool or accountId-shaped value); the contract is implemented and documented but unasserted, so a test is written and no bug is filed.

The rate-limit sweep asserts total <= 1 per member, which total == 0 (raising before reaching the client) satisfies vacuously; it must assert total == 1 and replace pytest.raises(Exception) with pytest.raises(BackendHTTPError) asserting code == 429.

The unknown-backend test never calls select_backend and only pins that BackendRegistryError is not a subclass of KeyError, so its name overreaches its assertion and must be broadened or renamed to agree.
Each rewritten test must be mutation-checked against the property it claims, biting on the actual behavior rather than merely being longer, with mutation and verdict recorded on the ticket.
